checkpoints.description: [1/4] Planning and architectural design: ADR-001, project structure, and pyproject.toml

impact_assessment.why: Bootstrap Chronos developer focus and session orchestrator with robust local storage
impact_assessment.benefits: Enables distraction-free session tracking, micro-milestone management, and productivity metrics
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CLI interface schema stability; dependency: none (standard library); concurrency: multi-process file locking; state: power-loss atomicity
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use strict data models, advisory file locks, atomic temp+fsync+replace writes, and thorough unit tests

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Domain models and atomic storage engine with full unit tests
[3/4] Session manager, task tracker, and metrics analytics with unit tests
[4/4] CLI interface, end-to-end integration tests, README documentation, and Phase 4 gate verification
[1/4] Plan: abort time accounting, stats window semantics, collision-free atomic temp names, schema-tolerant history listing

impact_assessment.why: An independent review confirmed: aborted sessions archive elapsed_seconds=0 and lose focus time, the stats day-window counts sessions up to 7d23h old and crashes on naive timestamps, atomic temp names can collide within one millisecond, and history rows missing identifiers raise KeyError, bricking every command
impact_assessment.benefits: Focus totals survive an abort, stats include exactly the last N days and ignore future-dated rows, concurrent writes cannot share a scratch path, and one malformed history row can no longer disable the CLI
impact_assessment.risks: contract: stats window tightens to elapsed time, abort archives non-zero elapsed_seconds; dependency: none added (stdlib tempfile); concurrency: temp names become collision-free; state: on-disk JSON schema unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for each behaviour change, full 'aikit check chronos' before the commit, backward-compatible defaults

checkpoints.description: [4/4] All fixes implemented and verified: 24/24 tests green, aikit check chronos 4/4 gates, ADR-002 recorded; checklists: passed
